rationale: The gap-fade thesis remains intact — price is below VWAP ($54.05) and the 9-EMA ($53.22), sitting in the bottom 12% of today's range on 4.55x relative volume with a mildly risk-off tape (SPY -0.20%, VIXY +0.81%).
